{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with highest sample_seq for each patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter to treatment arm
treatment_only = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute fraction who responded
fraction_responded = treatment_only['responded'].mean()

print(f"Number of unique patients in treatment arm after deduplication: {len(treatment_only)}")
print(f"Number of responders in treatment arm: {treatment_only['responded'].sum()}")
print(f"Fraction responded: {fraction_responded}")"}
